selection: Development-only net R per planned risk; require >=12 trades, positive mean R and no breach under both cost scenarios. One target/window jointly chosen before reading later-period ranking. All history has been examined before, so later period is only a consistency check.
room_gate: At least 2 price R to prior mean for ALL targets; target change does not loosen the entry filter.
deadline: Most profiles hold to open+300min even after entry cutoff. Separate close90 and goldlab_timing profiles test holding deadline.
timezone: London benchmark08:00 Europe/London; NY benchmark08:30 America/New_York. NYSE stock open09:30 is not the benchmark. Exact local times, DST aware.
old_timing: Locally verified: London08:00–11:00, earliest ORB entry08:45; NY08:30–11:30, earliest09:15, last eligible signal10:00 inclusive. This studies only those timing boundaries with the NEW strategy, not old ORB logic.
